assessment.inScopeSystems: Marlow SCADA/OT network; primary & standby control servers; engineering workstations; process historian; IT/OT boundary firewalls
assessment.teamMembers:
J. Okafor (OT security)
L. Marsh (governance & policy)
S. Idris (detection & response)
assessment.clientOwner: M. Chen, Head of Operational Technology
assessment.evidenceLocation: GRC platform › CAF 2026 › Marlow; evidence pack ref EVP-2026-014
assessment.method: Interviews with system owners, documentation review, and configuration inspection of in-scope OT assets. Ratings reflect assessor judgement against CAF v4.0 IGPs. Live exploit testing was out of scope for the OT environment.

summary.note: Maturity percentages are calculated over rated outcomes only (Achieved / Partially Achieved / Not Achieved). Outcomes justified as Not Applicable are excluded from the denominator. Outcomes not yet addressed are excluded and flagged under completeness.

byObjective.title: Minimising Impact of Cyber Security Incidents

improvementPlan.name: Privileged User Management
improvementPlan.action: Establish periodic access re-certification for OT accounts; implement just-in-time privileged access.

improvementPlan.name: Generating Alerts
improvementPlan.action: Deploy OT-specific detection use cases; tune rules to reduce false positives; test alerting.

improvementPlan.name: Triage of Security Alerts
improvementPlan.action: Build OT alert context into triage runbooks; document triage; use findings to drive improvement.

improvementPlan.name: Secure Configuration
improvementPlan.action: Extend vulnerability scanning to the OT segment (passive where active is unsafe); remove default credentials.

improvementPlan.name: Backups
improvementPlan.action: Implement a 3-2-1 backup strategy; rehearse OT configuration restores; air-gap critical backups.

improvementPlan.name: Response and Recovery Capability
improvementPlan.action: Confirm response resources and decision authority; duplicate key roles; test back-up activation; retain external IR support on standby.

improvementPlan.name: Cyber Security Training
improvementPlan.action: Deploy role-based training for OT engineers on secure operations; include phishing simulation; track completion.

improvementPlan.name: Decision-making
improvementPlan.action: Establish risk appetite statement; implement risk-based decision framework for OT/IT.

improvementPlan.name: Understanding User's and System's Behaviour, and Threat Intelligence
improvementPlan.action: Baseline OT traffic behaviour; correlate threat intelligence to in-scope assets.

improvementPlan.name: Testing and Exercising
improvementPlan.action: Run regular exercises drawing on threat intelligence and past incidents; test the full response cycle including restoration; feed findings into lessons learned.

improvementPlan.name: Response Plan
improvementPlan.action: Develop and test an incident response plan grounded in risk assessment; cover known and novel attack patterns; integrate supply-chain scenarios.

improvementPlan.name: Sources and Tools for Logging and Monitoring
improvementPlan.action: Extend logging to OT sources including PLC events; ensure coverage supports timely detection.

improvementPlan.name: Secure Software Development and Support
improvementPlan.action: Impose secure development requirements on software suppliers; require SBOM and NIST SSDF / SDL evidence.

improvementPlan.name: Policy, Process and Procedure Implementation
improvementPlan.action: Implement policy compliance monitoring; extend coverage to the OT estate; integrate into assurance.

improvementPlan.name: Securing Logs
improvementPlan.action: Centralise log collection; protect log integrity; hold logs for a suitable retention period.

improvementPlan.name: Device Management
improvementPlan.action: Implement certificate-based device management; retire shared local accounts on legacy HMIs.

improvementPlan.name: Identity and Access Management (IdAM)
improvementPlan.action: Conduct access rights review; authenticate field devices; automate the joiners/movers/leavers process.

improvementPlan.name: Data in Transit
improvementPlan.action: Audit data-in-transit protection; deploy TLS across the IT/OT boundary; document residual cleartext by design.

improvementPlan.name: Risk Management Process
improvementPlan.action: Implement formal risk management process with regular review cycles at system level.

improvementPlan.name: Threat Hunting
improvementPlan.action: Establish a threat-hunting programme for the OT environment; adopt a structured methodology; train hunters.

improvementPlan.name: Cyber Security Culture
improvementPlan.action: Run a security awareness programme; embed security in culture; deliver leadership messaging.

improvementPlan.name: Assurance
improvementPlan.action: Define assurance programme; conduct penetration testing and independent reviews of the risk methodology.

improvementPlan.name: Supply Chain
improvementPlan.action: Conduct supply chain review; add security clauses to contracts; assess fourth-party risk.

improvementPlan.name: Secure by Design
improvementPlan.action: Define and formalise a secure baseline for engineering hosts and PLC/RTU devices; minimise attack surface.

improvementPlan.name: Secure Management
improvementPlan.action: Constrain OT patch windows to vendor-supported releases; establish change management and patch SLAs.

improvementPlan.name: Resilience Preparation
improvementPlan.action: Define OT-specific RTO/RPO; test BCP/DR plans; document recovery procedures for the essential function.

improvementPlan.name: Understanding Threat
improvementPlan.action: Adopt threat analysis methodology (e.g. attack trees); integrate threat intelligence feeds and model likely attack scenarios against the essential function.

improvementPlan.name: Policy, Process and Procedure Development
improvementPlan.action: Develop comprehensive security policy suite aligned to risk; set a review schedule; track exceptions.

improvementPlan.name: Personnel Skills for Monitoring and Detection
improvementPlan.action: Assess monitoring skills and tooling gaps; upskill or augment the SOC for OT competency.

contributingOutcomes.name: Board Direction
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Board-approved cyber strategy CYB-STR-2026 v3; quarterly review minuted (BM-2026-Q2, item 4).

contributingOutcomes.name: Roles and Responsibilities
contributingOutcomes.evidence: CISO reports to Board; OT risk standing item; delegated authority matrix RACI-OT-02.

contributingOutcomes.name: Decision-making
contributingOutcomes.evidence: OT decisions still routed through IT governance; no separate OT risk acceptance route. Gap logged RISK-118.

contributingOutcomes.name: Risk Management Process
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Enterprise risk register covers OT at asset-group level; per-system granularity for Marlow outstanding.

contributingOutcomes.name: Understanding Threat
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Threat briefings consumed from NCSC & WISER; not yet formally modelled against Marlow attack paths.

contributingOutcomes.name: Assurance
contributingOutcomes.evidence: No independent assurance of the risk methodology to date; first external review scheduled Q4.

contributingOutcomes.name: Asset Management
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Asset register in CMDB reconciled monthly; OT assets tagged; last reconciliation 2026-08-01.

contributingOutcomes.name: Supply Chain
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Supplier security schedules in place for two of four critical OT vendors; remaining two in contract renewal.

contributingOutcomes.name: Secure Software Development and Support
contributingOutcomes.evidence: No secure development requirements imposed on the SCADA integrator; identified in supply-chain review SC-07.

contributingOutcomes.principleTitle: Service Protection Policies, Processes and Procedures
contributingOutcomes.name: Policy, Process and Procedure Development
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Security policies published; OT-specific procedures partially drafted; awareness of exceptions inconsistent.

contributingOutcomes.principleTitle: Service Protection Policies, Processes and Procedures
contributingOutcomes.name: Policy, Process and Procedure Implementation
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Policy compliance measured for IT; OT coverage manual and infrequent.

contributingOutcomes.name: Identity Verification, Authentication and Authorisation
contributingOutcomes.evidence: MFA enforced for all remote and privileged access to the Marlow environment; jump-host mandated.

contributingOutcomes.name: Device Management
contributingOutcomes.evidence: PAM deployed for engineering workstations; some legacy HMI local accounts remain shared. Remediation RISK-091.

contributingOutcomes.name: Privileged User Management
contributingOutcomes.evidence: No periodic access re-certification for OT accounts; last full review >18 months ago.

contributingOutcomes.name: Identity and Access Management (IdAM)
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Device certificates issued for new PLCs; legacy field devices unauthenticated on the process network.

contributingOutcomes.name: Understanding Data
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Data flows for Marlow documented in DFD-Marlow-v2; classification applied.

contributingOutcomes.name: Data in Transit
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Data-in-transit encrypted across the IT/OT boundary; intra-OT process traffic remains cleartext by design constraint.

contributingOutcomes.name: Stored Data
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Backups encrypted at rest; offline copy held; restore tested 2026-07 (RT-2026-07).

contributingOutcomes.name: Mobile Data
contributingOutcomes.justification:
Exemption: mobile data outcome does not apply to the Marlow OT environment in scope.
Justification: no mobile or portable devices are permitted to process or store operational data within the OT security boundary; the environment is fixed-terminal only, enforced by device-control policy DEV-CTL-03 and physical port lockdown.
Compensating controls: all data access is via hardwired HMI terminals inside the controlled area, with badge-in physical access logging and USB mass-storage blocked at the endpoint.

contributingOutcomes.name: Media / Equipment Sanitisation
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Media sanitisation to NCSC guidance; destruction certificates retained.

contributingOutcomes.name: Secure by Design
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Secure baseline defined for Windows engineering hosts; PLC/RTU hardening baseline not yet formalised.

contributingOutcomes.name: Secure Configuration
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Vulnerability scanning does not extend to the OT segment; passive discovery only. Gap RISK-104.

contributingOutcomes.name: Secure Management
contributingOutcomes.evidence: IT patched to policy; OT patch windows constrained by vendor support and availability requirements.

contributingOutcomes.name: Vulnerability Management
contributingOutcomes.evidence: IT/OT segmentation via firewall with documented conduit ruleset; reviewed 2026-06.

contributingOutcomes.name: Resilience Preparation
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Resilience requirements defined for the essential function; OT-specific RTO/RPO under review.

contributingOutcomes.name: Design for Resilience
contributingOutcomes.evidence: N+1 for critical control components; tested failover of primary SCADA server 2026-05.

contributingOutcomes.name: Backups
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Backups verified for IT; OT configuration backups held but restore not routinely rehearsed.

contributingOutcomes.name: Cyber Security Culture
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Annual awareness training completed by 88% of staff; OT-specific module in development.

contributingOutcomes.name: Cyber Security Training
contributingOutcomes.evidence: No role-based training for OT engineers on secure operations; identified in TNA-2026.

contributingOutcomes.name: Sources and Tools for Logging and Monitoring
contributingOutcomes.evidence: IT logs to SIEM; OT logging limited to firewall and jump-host; PLC event capture minimal.

contributingOutcomes.name: Securing Logs
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Log retention 12 months for IT; OT log integrity protection inconsistent.

contributingOutcomes.name: Generating Alerts
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Alerting rules tuned for IT estate; no OT-specific detection use cases deployed. Backlog DET-12.

contributingOutcomes.name: Triage of Security Alerts
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Triage runbooks do not cover OT alert context; analysts lack process-network familiarity.

contributingOutcomes.name: Personnel Skills for Monitoring and Detection
contributingOutcomes.evidence: SOC (outsourced) has IT skills; OT monitoring competency being built via joint exercises.

contributingOutcomes.name: Understanding User's and System's Behaviour, and Threat Intelligence
contributingOutcomes.evidence: No behavioural baselining of OT traffic; threat intel not yet correlated to Marlow assets.

contributingOutcomes.name: Threat Hunting
contributingOutcomes.evidence: No proactive threat hunting performed in the OT environment to date.

contributingOutcomes.name: Response Plan
contributingOutcomes.evidence: IR plan exists and references OT; supply-chain incident scenarios not yet incorporated.

contributingOutcomes.name: Response and Recovery Capability
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Retainer with external IR provider in place, but OT-specific response playbook and back-up activation procedures are not yet defined; capability cannot yet be evidenced end-to-end.

contributingOutcomes.name: Testing and Exercising
contributingOutcomes.evidence: Tabletop exercises run for IT scenarios only; no OT/process-disruption exercise conducted.

contributingOutcomes.name: Post Incident Analysis
contributingOutcomes.justification:
Exemption: this contributing outcome is declared not applicable for the current assessment period only.
Justification: no cyber security incidents affecting the Marlow essential function have occurred since the environment entered scope, so there is no post-incident analysis to evidence. This is a point-in-time position, not a permanent exemption.
Note: the analysis capability itself is defined in the IR plan (see D1.a) and will be evidenced against the next qualifying incident or exercise.
